'''Akein''' is a horse owned by [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]], who received it as a gift from [[Matrim Cauthon]]. 

==Appearance==
Akein is an extremely well shaped horse that even Mat counted his luck on finding. 

==History==
Akein is a razor, a type of horse owned by [[Domani]] bloodborn, which gets its name from the way that the colors of its fur meet each other in neat, straight lines.{{ref/book|11|6}}

==Activities==
Mat bought Akein from a town while on the road to escape [[Altara]] and gave it to Tuon a few days later, who rode it like the wind before naming it in the [[Old Tongue]] for "swallow."{{ref/book|11|8}}

Tuon took Akein back to [[Ebou Dar]] with [[Karede]] and [[Selucia]], who rode [[Rosebud]].{{ref/book|11|36}}
